test_blaser2_ref: test the blaser reference-based model predictions against hardcoded expected values
test_blaser2_qe: test the blaser referenceless QE model predictions against hardcoded expected values
create_blaser_model: create a BlaserModel instance from a BlaserConfig dataclass with embedding and MLP parameters
load_blaser_model: load a pre-trained blaser model by name from the model hub using get_blaser_model_hub
run_blaser_inference: run blaser inference on source, machine-translated, and reference embeddings to produce a quality score
